'''Gellar Domo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], who lived during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Domo was a member of the [[Intarsa League]], a criminal organization that operated in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. He worked his way up through the organization by working as an enforcer and a "hard man" for it. When [[Dersa Welles]] became leader of the League, Domo followed her, as he believed that she was a strong leader. When the League captured the [[Blue Star Centre]], on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], in around [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], Domo took up a defensive position in one of the Centre's office buildings.
